# JESI Components & Service Categories Table
```{r}
# pull data
ntee_codes <- st_read(con, query = "SELECT * from jeni_jesi_2021.jesi_codes_public")



#create and format table
datatable(ntee_codes,
class = 'cell-border stripe',
colnames=c(
'JESI Component'='jesi_component',
'JESI Service Category'='jesi_category',
'NTEE Code'='ntee_code',
'IRS Common Code Description'='common_code_description',
'IRS NTEE Code Description'='ntee_description',
'JESI Organization Count'='organization_count'
),
``` 
